player_prompt.intro:
I player {player_id} ni e, Connect Four-ah.
Nang disc symbol: {symbol}.
Game board-ah hian {num_rows} rows leh {num_cols} columns a awm.
Players te chuan an disc an column zawkah (0 atanga {end_col}) an tichhia ṭhin.
An disc ṭhenkhat (an mah) pali an connect (vertically, horizontally, emaw diagonally) hian a chak ṭhin.
Nang turn ah, i column number squared brackets-ah i chhut ang che, '[col 4]' emaw '[col 1]' emaw ang.

board.board_notvisible_state: Game board chu player-te'n an hmu thei lo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Action format dik lo. Format ṭha: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Action dik lo. Column {col} a pawimawh lo.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Action dik lo. Column {col} a khawlh tawh.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} an disk {player_symbol} column {col}-ah a tichhia.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} chuan pali a zawmin a hneh!
outcome.draw: Inkhel chu a inhnehtawk ta mai.
